newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian govt senator Short quits - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian govt senator Short quits - Costello.

text.p: Former Australian assistant treasurer and now backbench senator Jim Short will quit parliament to take up a government-nominated job in May, Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday.

Short, a former treasury official, resigned from the assistant treasurership over a conflict of interest -- he had made a ministerial decision that could have been seen to benefit a company in which he had interest.
Costello said the government had nominated Short to take the position of alternate executive director at the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development in London.
"Senator Short will resign from the Senate to take up his position later in May," Costello said.
Resignations from the Senate between elections do not spark by-elections. The government of the departing senator's home state merely appoints a replacement from the senator's party.
Costello said Short was suitable for the new job because of his ministerial and treasury background.
